correctness.rationale: The theorem is an explicitly conditional deduction from the published exact congruence classification. Class reductions modulo 24 were derived in both directions. The discarded higher powers and p-dividing-m exclusions are O(sqrt(X)); fixed-modulus PNT and a truncation at (log X)^4 yield an O(X/log^3 X) remainder. The first coefficient is pi^2/12 and the second equals pi^2/12 times (1+4log2/3-5log3/4-2zeta prime(2)/zeta(2)). An independent Dirichlet-sum numeric check and exact coefficient/congruence verifiers agreed. No proof of the cited classification or PNT is claimed.
